That rules out GERD and rhinitis as primary triggers. Given your history of heavy smoking, the chronic cough, and the specific finding of a prominent hilar shadow on the X-ray, do you have a persistent cough that lasts more than 8 weeks per year, even when you aren't currently smoking?
